word_order: SVO | Subjects precede verbs and objects in canonical clauses (e.g. “Stars give off light” = S V O).
register: encyclopedic / edited written prose (formal, factual descriptions like encyclopedia or reference articles).
notes_for_prompt_writer: This corpus is formal, edited English: avoid eager splits after subordinators, prepositional phrases, infinitival 'to', or single coordinating connectors (they often lead into the rest of the clause). Keep relative/complement clauses introduced by that/which/who attached to their head noun or verb. Favor emitting a unit once a main verb phrase and its core object/complements are complete rather than immediately after short adverbials or discourse markers.
